name: tb_seep
purpose: a thin wet hissing thread of dark corrupted magic flung forward, slimy whispering rot

name: tb_open_vessel
purpose: a slow deep reversed whoosh of dark wind being sucked inward into a body, swelling and ending in a low shudder

name: tb_pass_it_on
purpose: a thick gush of dark corrupted magic pushed from the hands into an enemy, sickly wet whoosh ending in a hit

name: tb_return
purpose: a cursed ward snapping open and dark magic thrown back, a sharp sour crack with a hissing tail

name: tb_spillover
purpose: dark rot bursting outward from a body in a ring, a wet splattering dark magic explosion

name: tb_fouled_ground
purpose: thick dark corrosive liquid splashing down and soaking into a metal floor, sizzling and bubbling

name: tb_rot_gather
purpose: dark energy drawn inward to a single point, a rising sucking whine of black magic

name: tb_rot_through
purpose: a corrupted body bursting open, a heavy wet dark magic blast with splatter

name: tb_taint_spread
purpose: a short wet hiss of dark corruption jumping to a new host
